summary.zh: 0.1.1 修复 0.1.0 在 macOS 上无法启动的严重问题。根因是 CI 在无 Apple 证书时走 ad-hoc 签名路径，但只重签了主程序与 Helper，漏签了 Electron Framework——主程序（无 Team ID）与 Framework（Electron 官方 Team ID）Team ID 不一致，macOS dyld 在加载 framework 时直接终止进程，表现为双击无反应/闪退。本次在 electron-builder 的 afterSign 钩子里补全全量 ad-hoc 重签，统一包内所有 Mach-O 组件的签名身份，启动恢复正常。
summary.en: 0.1.1 fixes a critical issue where 0.1.0 could not launch on macOS. The root cause: CI's certificate-less ad-hoc signing path re-signed only the main executable and Helpers, leaving Electron Framework with its original Electron Team ID. The Team ID mismatch between the main process (no Team ID) and the framework (Electron's Team ID) caused macOS dyld to terminate the process while loading the framework — appearing as a silent crash on launch. This release adds a full ad-hoc re-sign step in electron-builder's afterSign hook, unifying the signing identity of every Mach-O component in the bundle, so the app launches normally.

title.zh: 修复 macOS 启动崩溃：统一 ad-hoc 签名 Team ID
title.en: Fix macOS launch crash: unify ad-hoc signing Team ID

summary.zh: 新增 electron-builder afterSign 钩子（resign-adhoc.cjs），在无 Apple 证书时把包内所有 Mach-O 组件（Electron Framework、各 Helper、computer-use helper、主程序）统一重签为 ad-hoc，消除主程序与 Framework 的 Team ID 不一致——这正是 0.1.0 在 macOS 上 dyld 加载 framework 即 SIGABRT 的根因。同时把 CI 里被硬编码为常开的 SKIP_NOTARIZE 改为「仅在无公证凭据时跳过」，配齐 Apple 凭据后可无缝切到正规签名+公证。
summary.en: Adds an electron-builder afterSign hook (resign-adhoc.cjs) that, when no Apple certificate is present, re-signs every Mach-O component in the bundle (Electron Framework, Helpers, computer-use helper, main executable) to a unified ad-hoc identity, eliminating the Team ID mismatch between the main process and the framework — the root cause of 0.1.0's dyld SIGABRT on macOS launch. The CI's hardcoded-always-on SKIP_NOTARIZE is also corrected to 'skip only when notary credentials are absent', so adding Apple credentials later switches to proper signing + notarization with no further changes.

details.zh: 崩溃报告铁证：codeSigningTeamID 为空（主程序 ad-hoc），加载 Electron Framework 时报 'mapping process and mapped file have different Team IDs'，启动 30ms 内被 dyld 终止。
details.en: Crash report evidence: codeSigningTeamID was empty (ad-hoc main process), and loading Electron Framework failed with 'mapping process and mapped file have different Team IDs' — dyld terminated the process within 30ms of launch.

details.zh: 对比验证：本地 install:local 走的 sign-local.cjs 全量 ad-hoc 重签能正常启动，但 CI 发布流程从未执行该步骤，发布的 0.1.0 是半残 ad-hoc。
details.en: Comparative verification: the local install:local path runs sign-local.cjs for a full ad-hoc re-sign and launches fine, but the CI release pipeline never ran that step, so the published 0.1.0 was a half-signed ad-hoc build.

sources.title: ci: macOS 无证书时跳过签名/公证（ad-hoc），build-server 失败输出日志
